services.name: Whooping Crane & Coastal Birding Tour
services.desc: Birding is our passion! 3 Hours Texas Boat Safari guarantees you’ll see whooping cranes and we typically point out 30 to 60 different species during our 3-hour trip. We are based right in the middle of one of the best birding areas in the US and our mission is to provide you with the best birding experience possible. You never know what you might see! Capt. Tommy and his experienced guides will teach you as much as you want to learn on how to ID some of the over 400 species that have been documented along the Texas Coastal Bend. We require a minimum of 10 be signed up in 3 Hour Tour · All ages

services.name: Aransas Bay Dolphin Watching Cruise
services.desc: Dolphin Watching Trips Depart Fulton Harbor in search of Atlantic Bottle-nosed Dolphin on this 1.25 hour cruise. We will spend time watching these amazing creatures very closely as they feed behind the local shrimp fleet. You will see dolphins and birds as well as learn how local shrimp are caught. 1.25 Hours Availability Cruise Runs From Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Experience the Wildlife & Beauty of Aransas Bay · 1.25 Hours

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: running May - September See wildlife and pristine shorelines along San Jose Island before catching the sunset over the bay! We will depart Fulton Harbor and head over to the smooth protected waters along San Jose Island to see nesting birds and other wildlife and then watch the sun set over the bay on this 2 hour cruise. Availability Cruises Run From Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day 1.5 Hours · All Ages Welcome!

services.name: Spring Rookery Tour
services.desc: On this 4 hour trip we visit 3-4 different rookeries and travel through 6 different bays to witness one of nature's true spectacles. 4 Hours About This is a great opportunity to view many different species of colonial waterbirds courting, sparring, nest-building, and feeding their chicks later in the season. All of the birds are in their breeding plumage offering outstanding photo opportunities. This is a great trip for new birders with lots of action so come relax and enjoy the Ages 12+ · 4 Hours · This is a tour you wont forget!

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: If you want to get your group out on the water you have come to the right place! About You have 2 options; for up to 6 passengers, the "Turnstone", our 22 foot Grady White deep V walk through is a cost effective option. For up to 37 passengers, the "Skimmer "our 40 foot flagship will get your group on the water for just about any occasion. Outing options include Birding Tours, Dolphin Watching, Sunset Cruise, Water Taxi, History Tour, Cocktail Cruise, Photo Trips, Bachelor/Bachelorette Parties, Weddings, Etc. Give us a call at 361 463 5003 for more info on the Groups up to 37 People
